resources.string: Turn boost on, plug into the car, play music. Drag the slider until it sounds right.
Boost on — waiting to lock onto Spotify
Only when USB / car is connected
Play music, tap Turn on. If volume does not jump, pause Spotify and press play.
Boost on — waiting for USB / car
Boost is on, but “Only when USB / car is connected” is enabled, so it will not change the phone speaker. Turn that switch off to test at home.
Boosting the phone speaker. Drag the slider — volume should jump.
Spotify is playing, but boost is not attached yet. Pause, then press play — that is how Android hands over the sound.
Play Spotify (or YouTube Music), then pause and press play so boost can lock on.
Boost is off. Tap Turn on when you want it.
USB / Android Auto — boost is on.
Bluetooth — boost is on if this is the car.
On the phone speaker — plug into the car, or turn off “Only in the car / USB”.
